subject: Accepted-1995 original-client gate-to-wounded-soldier dialogue boundary
scope: Isolated copied Auth/Game/DB and recovered original client 1.16.5.0; normal deployed-derived combat and ordinary client movement/use. The private copied Game DLL logged accepted Move positions only. Live Game and DIT were untouched. All sessions began with mission 1995 already accepted at Youngblood's checkpoint; these sessions do not verify acceptance and soldier interaction in one continuous login.

observations.source_location: continuous_soldier_dialogue/output/positions.tsv and soldier prompt/dialogue screenshots; copied DB objective rows in manifest
observations.finding: In one accepted-1995 original-client session, ordinary rifle fire killed the gate Thrax, north-side ordinary movement reached (-102.043,86.266,70.980), and the client displayed 'Press [Mouse Button 2] to talk'. Ordinary right-click opened the Human Objective Completion dialogue with Conrad/EMP text. The Continue button was visible but the controller's general OCR missed it, so no Continue click occurred; copied objective 1995/2 remained pending. This verifies a continuous gate-to-soldier-dialogue path through the reconstructed encounter, not objective completion.

observations.source_location: north_overshoot_death/output/positions.tsv, output/10-soldier-aim-1.png, copied game log and DB state
observations.finding: A later route reached (-103.789,86.652,71.723) after a longer north strafe. The Human was left of the reticle and no talk prompt appeared. Outpost creature 2760 killed the recruit during an aim correction; objective 1995/2 remained pending.

A faster branch reached (-103.516,87.367,73.672) alive. The Human and objective marker were left of the reticle; a bounded +40 horizontal mouse correction did not reveal the talk prompt. The controller stopped without right-click; objective 1995/2 remained pending.

A planned leftward camera correction was not reached. The near-outpost point varied to (-91.066,85.137,72.391), and the first one-second D strafe reached (-94.879,86.270,76.836), 0.336 m beyond the controller's measured north-band cap. The controller stopped safely before soldier interaction; this is a route-controller bound, not evidence of a game mechanic failure.

observations.source_location: adaptive_continue_attempt_stopped_at_short_strafe/output/06-near-outpost-loc.png, output/positions.tsv and driver log; compare continuous_soldier_dialogue north-strafe trace
observations.finding: The next accepted-1995 run again killed the gate Thrax. Near the outpost it reached (-94.168,85.215,69.422), then D1 reached (-95.676,85.742,72.629). A following D0.4 yielded only (-95.789,85.766,72.867), so the controller stopped before the soldier. The first D endpoint is about 0.22 m horizontally from the earlier successful D1 endpoint (-95.809,85.766,72.922), where a later D0.5 reached (-97.484,86.270,76.359). The short movement could reflect input or accepted-Move timing, transient contact, or local collision; one probe does not establish a static blocker. No talk prompt or Continue click was attempted, and objective 1995/2 remained pending.

The private copied Game DLL with accepted-Move yaw telemetry passed copied Auth/Game readiness. A first client attempt reached playable HUD but its initial Return inputs did not open Local chat; the controller stopped before /loc or movement. A later short post-load settle corrected this startup input timing in the next run.

observations.source_location: yaw_enabled_launcher_sigterm/output/positions.tsv, copied game log, launcher session exit 143 and controller log
observations.finding: With the post-load settle, the original client submitted /loc, killed the gate Thrax and reached the fence accepted-Move point (-4.832,99.078,125.324) at yaw 1.0596. The copied launcher then exited 143/SIGTERM before the next command result, and the controller timed out; objective 1995/2 remained pending. The copied game log ended with regular Ping traffic and no recorded exception. Accessible journal entries did not identify the signal sender; system/kernel journal visibility was limited. This is an infrastructure interruption, not a gameplay or soldier-route result.

offline_button_check: The captured Human dialogue's 150x30 crop at screen offset (15,600), enlarged 400%, grayscale threshold 45%, Tesseract psm 11 reads 'Continue'; the pre-dialogue crop reads empty. The candidate click is approximately (75,617), but no continuous-session button click has been verified.
status: Gate-to-wounded-soldier dialogue in one accepted-1995 session is verified in the copied emulator. Objective 2 to 3, same-session Conrad use, and final-live soldier placement and combat fidelity remain unverified.
yaw_telemetry_limit: The private copied Game DLL SHA-256 d0c2bbb28b9ae4734538e7ef50336d8a6311efde5370a31dbe0d68802b8daad6 added accepted Move yaw=ViewDirection.X and raw view_y=ViewDirection.Y without gameplay-rule edits. Its one client retry traced yaw only through the fence before unexplained copied-launcher SIGTERM; no north-side yaw correction was tested. The original client and live Game/DIT were not modified.
next_bounded_check: At the variable near-outpost start, adapt short D holds to a north waypoint by accepted-Move telemetry. If a single short hold yields little displacement near (-95.7,72.6), capture and recheck with one bounded probe rather than treating static collision as proven; stop on repeated blockage or route divergence. At the soldier, require the original Human talk prompt before right-click; use small measured camera corrections if the actor is visibly off-reticle. If the Conrad/EMP Objective Completion panel and Continue crop appear, click Continue once and verify copied DB objective 2 complete/objective 3 active. Do not infer completion from the dialogue alone.
